terms.title: Terms of Service · Summary
terms.intro: This service is jointly provided by a simulated VASP and partner bank. Please read the terms below carefully before use.
terms.scope: Scope: Spot trading, TWD/crypto deposits and withdrawals, KYC and asset custody — bound by Taiwan's AML Act and FSC VASP rules.
terms.kyc: Mandatory KYC: Per Article 5 of the FSC VASP AML/CFT regulations, users without verified identity cannot trade or withdraw.
terms.trust: Trust custody: Customer TWD assets are held in the partner bank's VASP trust account, segregated from the operator's own funds, as required by the Virtual Asset Service Act.
terms.license: License disclosure: From 2026 onward, this service requires an FSC operating license to provide VASP services to Taiwan residents.
terms.termination: Termination: The platform may suspend or terminate accounts based on law, compliance requirements, or reasonable cause.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy · Summary
privacy.intro: To fulfil KYC, AML and regulatory reporting obligations, the platform must collect and retain the following personal data.
privacy.collected: Collected: Name, national ID, date of birth, contact info, bank account, KYC document images, IP and device info, transaction records.
privacy.purpose: Purpose: Identity verification, risk assessment, AML monitoring, CTR/SAR reporting, customer service and dispute handling.
privacy.retention: Retention: Per Article 10 of the AML Act, records are retained for at least 5 years.
privacy.thirdParty: Third-party disclosure: Partner banks (KYC matching, trust reconciliation), FSC and Investigation Bureau (statutory reporting), essential outsourced security/tech vendors.
privacy.rights: Your rights: You may request access, correction, or deletion (subject to statutory retention obligations) under the Personal Data Protection Act.

risk.title: Risk Disclosure
risk.intro: Virtual asset investment involves high risk. Please confirm you can bear the following risks before applying.
risk.volatility: Price volatility: Virtual asset prices are highly volatile and may go to zero in a short period. Past performance does not indicate future results.
risk.irreversible: On-chain irreversibility: Once crypto is withdrawn to an external address, it cannot be reversed. Wrong address or network results in permanent loss.
risk.custody: Custody risk: Even under trust custody, technical, human or third-party factors may cause assets to be temporarily inaccessible.
risk.regulatory: Regulatory risk: Changes in law may affect service scope, withdrawal channels, or trading limits.
risk.operational: Operational risk: System failures, business closure, or sanctions on the exchange or partner bank may affect your interests.

legal.intro: This platform's KYC flow is conducted under the following statutes and self-regulatory rules. Personal data collected here is used solely to fulfil these statutory obligations.

items.amlAct7Title: Money Laundering Control Act Art. 7 · Customer Due Diligence (CDD)
items.amlAct7Body: Financial institutions and virtual asset service providers must verify the customer's identity, retain identification documents and assess money-laundering and terrorist-financing risk before establishing a business relationship or executing transactions above a defined threshold. Name, national ID, date of birth, address and occupation in this form are mandatory under this article — accounts cannot be opened without them.
items.amlAct10Title: Money Laundering Control Act Art. 10 · Record Retention
items.amlAct10Body: Identity documents, review outcomes and subsequent change logs must be retained for at least 5 years from the termination of the business relationship. The platform must be able to produce the originals in full when requested by the FSC or the Investigation Bureau's Anti-Money Laundering Division.
items.vaspReg5Title: FSC VASP AML/CFT Regulation Art. 5 · Customer Due Diligence Procedures
items.vaspReg5Body: The FSC's sub-regulation operationalises the AML Act for VASPs into a three-step SOP: identity verification, beneficial-owner identification and risk assessment, with risk-tiered measures. This platform classifies customers into low / medium / high / critical risk levels based on this article.
items.vaspReg6Title: Same Regulation Art. 6 · Enhanced Due Diligence (EDD)
items.vaspReg6Body: Customers assessed as high-risk — politically exposed persons, residents of high-risk jurisdictions, or those with anomalous transaction patterns — must additionally provide source-of-wealth and source-of-funds documentation, with approval from a compliance officer required before the business relationship may be established.
items.vaspReg7Title: Same Regulation Art. 7 · Ongoing Due Diligence
items.vaspReg7Body: KYC is not 'verify once, valid forever'. When ID documents expire, transaction patterns deviate, addresses change, or the law is amended, the platform will proactively require resubmission. Non-compliance may result in account suspension.
items.vaspActBody: From 2026 VASPs must obtain an FSC operating licence, and customer assets must be segregated from the operator's own funds (this platform uses a partner-bank trust account). By statute, users without completed KYC may not trade or withdraw.
items.tierTitle: Virtual Asset Industry Association · Tier Self-Regulatory Framework
items.tierBody: Customers are classified into Tiers 0–3 based on KYC completeness, affecting daily / monthly deposit / withdrawal limits and asset access. Tier 0 can only browse markets; Tier 1 (basic identity) allows small trades; Tier 2 (with proof of address) raises limits; Tier 3 (with proof of wealth) unlocks the highest limits.

legal.footer: Article numbers may be updated as the regulators issue interpretive letters; data is transmitted over TLS and stored encrypted. See our Privacy Policy for details on retention and third-party disclosure.
